preconditions.description: The number of test cases t must be between 1 and 1000.
For each test case, l and r must be integers such that 1 <= l <= r <= 10^9.

postconditions.description: The output for each test case must be either 'YES' or 'NO'.

postconditions.expression: any((x % a >= a // 2) for x in range(l, r + 1))
postconditions.description: For each customer buying x cans, if x % a >= a // 2, they will buy a whole pack instead.
